source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    EntityName,
    SourceSchema,
    SourceTable,
    TargetTable,
    LoadType,
    WatermarkColumn,
    WatermarkDataType,
    BusinessDateColumn,
    LookbackDays,
    UpsertKeyColumn,
    LoadOrder
FROM ctl.IngestionConfig
WHERE IsActive = 1
ORDER BY LoadOrder

sqlReaderQuery.value:

']'
)

text.value:
@concat(
'
DECLARE @SourceCount BIGINT = ',
activity('LKP_SNAPSHOT_SOURCE_COUNT').output.firstRow.SourceRowCount,
';

DECLARE @RowsRead BIGINT = ',
activity('CPY_SNAPSHOT_TO_BRONZE').output.rowsRead,
';

DECLARE @TargetCount BIGINT = ',
activity('LKP_SNAPSHOT_TARGET_COUNT').output.firstRow.TargetRowCount,
';

IF @SourceCount = @RowsRead
   AND @SourceCount = @TargetCount
BEGIN

    UPDATE audit.TableRun
    SET
        EndTime = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        SourceRowCount = @SourceCount,
        RowsRead = @RowsRead,
        RowsWritten = @RowsRead,
        TargetRowCount = @TargetCount,
        RowsRejected = 0,
        Status = ''SUCCESS'',
        ErrorMessage = NULL
    WHERE PipelineRunId = ''',
pipeline().RunId,
'''
      AND EntityName = ''',
item().EntityName,
''';

END
ELSE
BEGIN

    UPDATE audit.TableRun
    SET
        EndTime = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        SourceRowCount = @SourceCount,
        RowsRead = @RowsRead,
        RowsWritten = @RowsRead,
        TargetRowCount = @TargetCount,
        Status = ''FAILED'',
        ErrorMessage = ''Snapshot source/target reconciliation failed''
    WHERE PipelineRunId = ''',
pipeline().RunId,
'''
      AND EntityName = ''',
item().EntityName,
''';

    THROW 50001, ''Snapshot source/target reconciliation failed'', 1;

END;
'
)

text.value:
@concat(
'
DECLARE @SourceCount BIGINT = ',
activity('LKP_SOURCE_COUNT').output.firstRow.SourceRowCount,
';

DECLARE @RowsRead BIGINT = ',
activity('CPY_INCREMENTAL_TO_BRONZE').output.rowsRead,
';

DECLARE @RowsWritten BIGINT = ',
activity('CPY_INCREMENTAL_TO_BRONZE').output.rowsCopied,
';

DECLARE @TargetCount BIGINT = ',
activity('LKP_INCREMENTAL_TARGET_COUNT').output.firstRow.TargetRowCount,
';

DECLARE @StartWatermark VARCHAR(200) = ''',
activity('LKP_PREVIOUS_WATERMARK').output.firstRow.LastSuccessfulWatermark,
''';

DECLARE @EndWatermark VARCHAR(200) = ''',
activity('LKP_CURRENT_HIGH_WATERMARK').output.firstRow.CurrentHighWatermark,
''';

IF @SourceCount = @RowsRead
   AND @SourceCount = @RowsWritten
   AND @SourceCount = @TargetCount
BEGIN

    UPDATE audit.TableRun
    SET
        EndTime = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        StartWatermark = @StartWatermark,
        EndWatermark = @EndWatermark,
        SourceRowCount = @SourceCount,
        RowsRead = @RowsRead,
        RowsWritten = @RowsWritten,
        TargetRowCount = @TargetCount,
        RowsRejected = 0,
        Status = ''SUCCESS'',
        ErrorMessage = NULL
    WHERE PipelineRunId = ''',
pipeline().RunId,
'''
      AND EntityName = ''',
item().EntityName,
''';

    UPDATE ctl.Watermark
    SET
        LastSuccessfulWatermark = @EndWatermark,
        LastSuccessfulRunId = ''',
pipeline().RunId,
''',
        UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME()
    WHERE EntityName = ''',
item().EntityName,
''';

END
ELSE
BEGIN

    UPDATE audit.TableRun
    SET
        EndTime = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        StartWatermark = @StartWatermark,
        EndWatermark = @EndWatermark,
        SourceRowCount = @SourceCount,
        RowsRead = @RowsRead,
        RowsWritten = @RowsWritten,
        TargetRowCount = @TargetCount,
        RowsRejected =
            CASE
                WHEN @SourceCount > @RowsWritten
                THEN @SourceCount - @RowsWritten
                ELSE 0
            END,
        Status = ''FAILED'',
        ErrorMessage = ''Incremental source/copy/target reconciliation failed''
    WHERE PipelineRunId = ''',
pipeline().RunId,
'''
      AND EntityName = ''',
item().EntityName,
''';

    THROW 50002, ''Incremental source/copy/target reconciliation failed'', 1;

END;
'
)
